svg.title: Pi TimeLens Step summaries in a real Pi terminal session
svg.desc: A faithful transcript redraw from Pi 0.85.1 at 120 columns. Two read tools run in parallel. TimeLens summarizes each model-and-tool Step, then shows one request Total with elapsed time, model time, tool time, tokens, cache, and subscription billing.
svg.metadata: Faithful redraw of tests/fixtures/real-pi-120.txt, selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 120 columns on 2026-09-08. Raw capture SHA-256: 2ebe64754733226cdd5c007fc1c4d9cecc8a0b4892c5b4c209d6109d22b80ce2. Transcript text, wrapping, ordering, measured values, and theme roles are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, model identifier, filesystem path, and assistant reasoning are omitted.
